'''Kuna's Horn''' was a [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]]&ndash;type [[Giant star|star]] located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Kuna's Horn system/Legends|same name]]. It was situated in the [[Outer Moddell systems]] area of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC KunaHorn" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] constituting the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC KunaHorn" /> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the [[Star/Legends|star]] to the [[Kuna's Fist system/Legends|Kuna's Fist system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Kuna's Horn was nearing the end of its stellar life and was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a motley collection of barren [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="TEA" /> It formed a part of the [[Kuna constellation]], which was named by the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]] in the [[Maya Kovel system/Legends|Maya Kovel system]].<ref name="Endor">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kuna's Horn was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
